description: Dept. of Local Government - Central Province - Notification made under section 66 (c) First Meeting of 30 Local Government Institutions. 2025
categorisation: This gazette announces the schedule for first meetings to elect Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Deputy Chairmen for various Local Government Institutions in Central Province. It falls under the Elections category as it specifically deals with electoral processes for local government positions, including dates, times, and venues for these election meetings, and is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
